caption:
Those who stress you out do not belong in your life 

#stress #wellnessjourney #healthybodyhealthymind #mindfulness
transcript: Those who stress you out do not belong in your life. Those who drain your energy do not belong in your circle. Those who play the victim, twist the story, or make you question your worth do not belong in your mind. Those who gossip, compete, compare, and never clap when you win do not belong in your business. Not everyone deserves a front row seat in your life. Some people only show up to block the view, clear the space, protect your peace. Your future does not need their chaos.
